ingredients.name: instant yeast
ingredients.raw: 1 tsp instant yeast (from a sachet or a tub)

ingredients.name: olive oil
ingredients.raw: 1 tbsp olive oil plus extra for drizzling

ingredients.name: fresh basil or dried basil
ingredients.raw: handful fresh basil or 1 tsp dried

ingredients.name: parmesan or vegetarian alternative
ingredients.raw: handful grated or shaved parmesan (or vegetarian alternative)

notes: Warm water is specified in method step1 but absent from recipeIngredient; extracted explicitly from method. Extra dusting flour and drizzling oil have no fixed amount. Sauce and assembled pizza are seasoned to taste; source does not identify every seasoning separately. Vessel tsp/tbsp/handful not converted into metric volume.
